evals.prompt: Red team this claim before it goes in the executive summary: 'our accelerator is 30% faster, so we'll lead the enterprise inference segment by 2027'. Attack it as hard as a hostile reviewer would.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Walks all seven attack vectors and names the specific attack on each, including vectors where no attack lands; Grades severity and computes a survival score out of 7; Returns a verdict of ship, hedge, rewrite or retract; Supplies the exact replacement wording when the verdict is hedge or rewrite.
expectations: Walks all seven attack vectors and names the specific attack on each, including vectors where no attack lands
Grades severity and computes a survival score out of 7
Returns a verdict of ship, hedge, rewrite or retract
Supplies the exact replacement wording when the verdict is hedge or rewrite

evals.prompt: What would a skeptical reviewer say about our headline takeaway? I want the holes poked in it now rather than by the board on Thursday.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Attacks the claim as written rather than a charitable paraphrase; Names at least one concrete counter-example or records that a search found none; Flags undefined terms and missing baselines rather than general worries.
expectations: Attacks the claim as written rather than a charitable paraphrase
Names at least one concrete counter-example or records that a search found none
Flags undefined terms and missing baselines rather than general worries

evals.prompt: This conclusion is about to propagate into three other decks. Stress-test the takeaway adversarially and tell me whether to ship it, hedge it or pull it.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Produces the vector-by-vector table with severities; Gives an explicit verdict tied to the survival score; Lists any attacks still open at ship time so they become stated limitations.
expectations: Produces the vector-by-vector table with severities
Gives an explicit verdict tied to the survival score
Lists any attacks still open at ship time so they become stated limitations

evals.prompt: The whole 12-page brief is drafted. Review it end to end before it ships — sourcing, limitations, whether it answers the question that was asked, and whether the next steps are actionable.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Runs the whole-document review rather than attacking a single claim; Returns a per-point status table with a publish verdict and specific fixes.
expectations: Runs the whole-document review rather than attacking a single claim
Returns a per-point status table with a publish verdict and specific fixes

evals.prompt: Before I write my rebuttal, help me put the opposing position in its strongest and most charitable form — the version its actual proponents would endorse.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Reconstructs the opposing case in its own terms rather than attacking it; Applies an endorsement test rather than producing a survival score.
expectations: Reconstructs the opposing case in its own terms rather than attacking it
Applies an endorsement test rather than producing a survival score
